declarations.description:
A site-header shell that arranges branding, navigation, actions and an optional mobile trigger. Navigation behaviour
remains the responsibility of slotted controls such as `c2-navigation-menu`.

A `sticky` header reports when page content scrolls beneath it: the host matches `:state(stuck)` and fires
`stuck-change`, and `--c2-header__stuck--box-shadow` applies. With `hide-on-scroll` it slides away while the reader
scrolls down and returns on the way up or when focus moves into it (`:state(retracted)`). The same behaviour is
available for any other content through `c2-sticky`.

members.name: sticky
members.description: Pins the header to the configured top offset.

members.name: hideOnScroll
members.description: Slides a `sticky` header out of view while the reader scrolls down, and back in on the way up.

members.name: blurred
members.description: Uses a translucent background and backdrop filter.

members.name: navigationLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the primary navigation landmark.

members.name: stickiness
members.default: new StickyController(this, { edge: () => 'top', hideOnScroll: () => this.hideOnScroll, onChange: (state, previous) => this.handleStickyChange(state, previous), })

members.name: stuck
members.description: Whether a `sticky` header is currently pinned to the top with page content scrolling beneath it.

members.name: retracted
members.description: Whether `hide-on-scroll` has currently slid the header out of view.

members.name: reveal
members.description: Brings a retracted header back into view.

events.name: stuck-change
events.description: Fired when a `sticky` header becomes stuck to the top or leaves it.

events.name: retract-change
events.description: Fired when `hide-on-scroll` slides the header out of view or back in.
